technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with extreme overbought conditions and exceptional volume spike, but weakened by absence of long-term trend alignment and low ADX conviction—suitable for tactical entry with tight risk management.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (411.84), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, CPI event imminent, and earnings binary 37 days out create hostile trading environment for discretionary consumer stocks.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (84.41) with 15x volume spike and three white soldiers pattern suggests capitulation exhaustion in fear-zone market, offering contrarian tactical entry near support (93.92) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: VIX crisis (411.84), macro recession signals (flat yield curve), earnings binary in 37 days, price below 200-EMA and 50-SMA, weak ADX conviction, and zero fundamental/institutional support create hostile environment that overwhelms short-term technical momentum.
